messages:
Olivia: Quick sync — NovaEdge wants to run a joint perf/W + throughput benchmark for the marketplace listing. Need a kernel-tune plan + telemetry schema. Who can lead this on Redwood's side? cc @Alex (NovaEdge) :wave:

Alex (NovaEdge): Hey! We have thermal telemetry + kernel patches ready. Goal: show perf/W across two instance SKUs (aws-c7g-large, gcp-a2-highgpu). Target kernels: v1.2 (tile-opt) and v1.3 (quant). Can share bench scripts and raw power logs.

Rajiv: I can own the Redwood runtime side for knobs + metric collection. Two quick asks: a) agree workload (propose Llama2-13B, seq=1024, batch=8, 1-shot prompts), b) unified CSV schema for artifacts. Proposed fields: model, seq_len, batch_size, throughput_tok_s, p95_lat_ms, power_w, gpu_util_pct, kernel_git_sha, run_tag.

Mia: Add quality checks — capture perplexity and a small EM-style eval on a 200-item prompt set so we don't regress with quant/tune. Also include random_seed and prompt_trace_hash.

Alex (NovaEdge): Agreed. We can provide IPMI power sampling plus a DC power meter trace. We'll tag kernel commits and push scripts to https://git.novaedge/bench/marketplace. Expect initial baseline runs by Wed.

Rajiv: Plan sketch: 1) kickoff call Mon 10:00 PT, 2) baseline runs on both clouds, 3) kernel patches + tuning pass, 4) final runs + artifact bundle. Can we get read access to your bench repo? Also need expected SLOs so we pick batch/cold-run counts (e.g., 5 warm, 50 measured samples).

Olivia: I'll schedule the kickoff and invite SRE, runtime, and product marketing. Alex — can you confirm NDA/data-sharing bits? Marketing will want to publicize numbers only after mutual signoff.

Alex (NovaEdge): NDA is fine — we'll do a "co-validated" badge workflow. For now we can share raw artifacts with Redwood RD.

bench-bot: Scheduled job created: bench-kickoff-1769999999 on Mon 10:00 PT. Reminder sent to participants.

Rajiv: Config snippet for the runtime workload (will include in repo):
```
model: "llama2-13b"
sequence_length: 1024
batch_size: 8
generate_tokens: 512
num_warmups: 5
num_measured: 50
telemetry: s3://redwood-bench/marketplace/1769999999/
metrics: [throughput_tok_s, p95_lat_ms, power_w, gpu_util_pct]
```

Mia: Thanks — I'll prepare the 200 eval prompts and a small scoring harness. Also propose we capture KV cache hit rate and host CPU power (for perf/W wall-to-wall).

Olivia: :thumbsup: I'll send the calendar invite and upload an onboarding checklist to Drive. Checklist items: repo access, power metering method, cloud SKUs, telemetry targets (s3 prefix), eval set, marketing contact. Anything missing?

Alex (NovaEdge): Add kernel build env (gcc/clang version), driver versions (NVIDIA kernel/driver or equivalent), and whether MIG or partitioning is used. Also note any BIOS thermal limits.

Rajiv: Good call. I'll draft the CSV schema and post an example row after this thread. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Olivia: Great — see you on Monday. If anyone needs to prep infra tickets before the call, drop them here and I'll triage. :rocket:
